response.overview: A salesman carrying an oversized album under his arm enters a businessman’s office. He opens the album. On the first page, there is a drawing of a gentleman in his room, reading a newspaper. The drawing transforms into a film scene: the man in the film rocks so vigorously in his rocking chair that he tips over. On the next page of the album, there is a film scene in which a gentleman is driven to the brink of madness by a toothache.
response.title: Das humoristische Album
